scope: Synthetic input and mocked empty SQL sessions only; no provider or database calls

vector_sql.sql:
SELECT doc_id, source_type, sample_id, event_id, time,
                   lat, lon, bay, station, title, text,
                   embedding <=> :emb AS distance
            FROM retrieval_document
            WHERE active IS TRUE AND embedding IS NOT NULL AND source_type = :source_type
            ORDER BY embedding <=> :emb
            LIMIT :k

SELECT doc_id, source_type, sample_id, event_id, time,
                       bay, station, title, text, lat, lon, metadata_json, provider,
                       provider_project_id, provider_run_id, assay_id,
                       assignment_method, sample_kind, is_control,
                       source_snapshot_id
                FROM retrieval_document
                WHERE active IS TRUE AND source_type = :source_type AND embedding IS NOT NULL
                ORDER BY embedding <=> :emb, doc_id ASC
                LIMIT :k
